```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
while(T){
    xy = sample(11:98,2)*sample(c(-1,1),2,T)
    x = xy[1]
    y = xy[2]

p1 = paste0("(",x,",",y,")",collapse="")
p2 = paste0("(",y,",",x,")",collapse="")

```

Question
========

Let $f$ represent a [one-to-one function](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Injective_function). Point $`r p1`$ is on the curve $y=f(x)$.

The inverse function's curve, $y=f^{-1}(x)$, has a corresponding point. What is the known point on the inverse function's curve? Type your answer with parentheses, with a comma separator, and without spaces. For example `(10,-99)`.



Solution
========

You simply swap the coordinates. Thus, the answer is $`r p2`$. You type the answer like ``r p2``.
